title: Froggy Moore, Spikes Brothers and the title's meaning
summary: Carew explains how Morton's Froggy Moore was split and republished, and debates whether the title refers to a contortionist or Freddie Moore.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
